findings.thing: the panel after the finger lifts
findings.text: after a three-second hold the panel opens, but in Chromium's touch emulation it closes again about 1 ms after the finger lifts, because a click lands on the dimmed backdrop and the backdrop closes the panel. A real phone may send no click after a long press, so Playtester should hold the lock for three seconds, lift, and see whether the panel stays
